penalties.details: Proceedings have been initiated by the Collector of Stamps, Government of NCT of Delhi under the provisions of the Indian Stamp Act, 1899 as applicable to the National Capital Territory of Delhi for determination of stamp duty payable in relation to issuance/allotment of 200,000 equity shares on April 11, 2022 and 200,000 equity shares on December 2, 2022 by the Company to the Info Edge Employee Stock Option Plan Trust. penalties.impact: The Company does not expect any material impact on its financials, operations or other activities arising from the said order and is taking appropriate legal steps in the matter.

operating_notes.text: Naukri database held 115 million resumes at March 2026, with about 21k resumes added daily in Q4FY26.
Recruitment India B2B billed customers rose to 146k in FY26 from 128k in FY25, with average realisation marginally lower at ₹146k.
Total deferred sales revenue was ₹1,498 Cr as of March 31, 2026, up from ₹1,357 Cr a year earlier.
Naukri platform hosts approximately 115 million resumes at the end of Q4 FY26.
Naukri resume database stood at 118 million as of June 30, 2026.
Recruitment India B2B billed customers were 49,000 in Q1FY27, down from 55,000 in Q4FY26.
99acres web traffic time share rose to 49% in Q1FY27 from 40% in Q1FY26.
Redstart Labs entered into an agreement to reduce its 13.38% stake in Psila Tech Pte. Ltd. to 0% via a capital reduction.
Subsidiary SIHL agreed to invest ₹5 Cr in Bizcrum Infotech (Bijnis) via Series B2 CCPS, taking its stake to 20.12%.

timeline.summary: Info Edge approved a ₹5 Cr investment in its wholly-owned subsidiary Startup Investments (Holding) Limited via CCDs.
2026-05-18: Info Edge approved ₹30 Cr investment in subsidiary SIHL via CCDs
2026-05-19: Info Edge files appeal before NCLAT against NCLT's April 7 order directing creditor meetings for amalgamation scheme
2026-05-22: Info Edge reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue up 17.2% YoY to ₹805 Cr with operating margin at 40.1%, and recommended a ₹3.60 final dividend.
Info Edge published the transcript of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call held on May 22, 2026.
Info Edge (India) Limited’s **Mr. Vineet Ranjan** to attend one-on-one meetings with Tata Mutual Fund, UTI Mutual Fund, and Renaissance Investment Managers on June 3, 2026, in Mumbai.

Info Edge (India) Limited’s **Jaya Bhatia** scheduled one-on-one meetings with **Millennium Partners** (June 5, 2026, virtual) and **Janchor Partners** (June 12, 2026, Noida) led by **Mr. Vineet Ranjan** and **Mr. Hitesh Oberoi** under SEBI’s Listing Regulations.
Info Edge approved a ₹200 Cr investment in its wholly-owned subsidiaries SISL and SIHL.
Info Edge announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary Redstart Labs will exit its 13.38% stake in Psila Tech through a capital reduction.
Info Edge approved a ₹5 Cr primary investment through its subsidiary SIHL in Bizcrum Infotech (Bijnis) for a 20.12% fully diluted stake.
